P.name: Nimble Fighter
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Fizz''' is permanently {{tip|ghosted}} and reduces every instance of {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} damage taken by 4 {{as|(+ 1% AP)}}, up to a maximum of 50% reduction. The damage reduction is increased to 14 {{as|(+ 1% AP)}} against {{tip|monsters}}.

Q.name: Urchin Strike
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fizz''' {{tip|dashes}} a fixed distance in the direction of the target enemy. If they are in range upon arrival, he deals {{as|magic damage}} plus {{as|100% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
Q.description2: ''{{ai|Seastone Trident|Fizz}} and {{ai|Chum the Waters|Fizz}} can be cast during the dash.''

W.name: Seastone Trident
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Fizz's''' basic attacks rend enemies {{tip|on-hit}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.
W.leveling: {{st|Total Passive Magic Damage|{{ap|30 to 90}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}|Passive Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|30/6 to 90/6|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25/6|round=2}}% AP)}}}}
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fizz''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 4 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}}, and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
W.description3: If ''Seastone Trident'' kills its target, the {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced to 1 second and the {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} is refunded. Otherwise, if the target is not killed, '''Fizz's''' basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}} for the next 5 seconds.
W.description4: ''Seastone Trident's'' active damage can be applied against {{tip|structures}} at 50% effectiveness. Active and on-hit damage deal an additional {{as|90 '''bonus''' magic damage}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
W.description5: ''Seastone Trident {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Fizz's''' basic attack timer.''

E.name: Playful
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fizz''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the target location while becoming {{tip|untargetable}}, balancing on his trident for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, during which he can cast ''{{ai|Trickster|Fizz}}'' after {{fd|0.15}} seconds into the duration.
E.description2: He then begins to hop off of his trident over {{fd|0.5}} seconds, during which he gains {{sti|{{as|50% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, and afterwards becoming targetable and landing to create a splash that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 2 seconds.
E.description3: ''While hopping off of the trident, '''Fizz''' may input movement commands to direct his landing.''

E.name: Trickster
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fizz''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the target location, hopping down and splashing onto the ground prematurely upon arrival to deal the same {{as|magic damage}} in a smaller radius but not applying the slow.

R.name: Chum the Waters
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fizz''' throws down a lure at the target location that attracts a shark, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area before it emerges to chomp at the lure after 2 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}}, though not through terrain, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 2 seconds. The further the lure travels in its initial flight, the larger the shark that is attracted; increasing ''Chum the Waters' '' damage, slow, eruption radius and knock back distance.
R.description2: {{sbc|Guppy (<455):}} 40% slow, 200 eruption radius and 150 unit knock back distance.
R.description3: {{sbc|Chomper (455-910):}} {{ap|(1+(1.5-1)*(1/2))*100}}% damage, 60% slow, 325 eruption radius and 250 unit knock back distance.
R.description4: {{sbc|Gigalodon (>910):}} {{ap|1.5*100}}% damage, 80% slow, 450 eruption radius and 350 unit knock back distance.
R.description5: Enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} can intercept the lure while it is in flight, which attaches to them upon contact and causes the shark to emerge at their position after the same delay. The lure's holder is {{tip|slow|slowed}} and {{tip|true sight|revealed}} for the duration and afterwards is impacted by the eruption but is {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for 1 second instead of knocked back.
